notes: Identity assessment: supplied frozen ResearchGate HTML text names Tetsuro Kobayashi, Asako Miura and Kazunori Inamasu and title Media Priming Effect: A Preregistered Replication Experiment (L55–L88), explicitly labels [Final Draft] (L90), and contains Methods, Results, tables, Discussion, References and Appendix. Title/authors and replication of Iyengar et al. Experiment 1 match neutral reference; this is a primary report draft rather than an abstract or preregistration. The replication DOI/journal header is not printed, so exact published-version identity remains unverified. No PDF supplied; canonical text has OCR spacing and no page markers, preventing resolution of p. 13. Description Media priming does not distinguish three outcomes or model specifications. Table 2 unstandardized interaction candidates, not selected targets: overall B=0.09, SE=0.16; competence B=0.13, SE=0.15; integrity B=0.02, SE=0.13 (L618–L643). Table 1 additionally prints separate control/treatment issue-performance slopes for pre/posttreatment measures (L485–L552). Original regression specification is referenced in Online Appendix OA3, not included here (L569–L582). Table 2 has SEs, star legend and nonsignificance narrative but no exact interaction p-values. Do not infer bounds from absent stars or substitute Table 3 treatment-effect p-values. Original side and n are unassigned placeholders only. No N arithmetic or effect-size conversion performed.
